seo_title: Emergency Mental Health Help | JS Neurominds, Tirupati
seo_description: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Urgent mental health guidance from JS Neurominds. This website is not an emergency service.
banner: This website is not an emergency service. If life is in danger right now, contact local emergency services immediately.
title: If you need urgent help
lede: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger or having thoughts of self-harm, please reach out for urgent help right away.
steps: Contact your nearest hospital emergency department.
Reach out to a trusted family member or friend who can be with you.
Call a local mental health helpline for immediate support (Tele-MANAS, India: 14416 or 1-800-891-4416, 24×7, free).
closing: You are not alone, and caring help is available. When you are safe, our clinic team is here to support your ongoing care.
